name: Eclipse FLAC Bridge
author: Personal Eclipse/MySpoti adapter
description: FLAC playback and downloads using your authorized Eclipse account. Automatically resumes Eclipse when Spotify Connect returns to your phone. Turn off MySpoti's Count extension plays on Spotify setting. Enter your addon URL and account token; instructions are shown beside each field. You may briefly hear Spotify audio while Eclipse loads on return.

settings.label: Eclipse addon URL
settings.description: Open https://eclipsemusic.app/account → Support the project → Eclipse addon → Copy. Paste your complete personal URL ending in /manifest.json here. Keep this link private.

settings.label: Eclipse account token
settings.description: On a PC, sign in at https://eclipsemusic.app/account. Press F12 → Application (or Storage) → Local Storage → https://eclipsemusic.app. Find eclipse_token and copy only its value, without quotes. Paste it here; this is not your Google password. If the key is missing, check that you signed in on that same domain. Keep the token private. The extension attempts to renew the session while it remains valid.

settings.label: Audio quality
settings.description: Request lossless FLAC. The actual quality depends on the stream returned by Eclipse.

settings.label: Resume Eclipse when returning to this phone (experimental)
settings.description: Turn off MySpoti's Count extension plays on Spotify setting. Return detection uses playback events and may wait until the next progress event (10 seconds).

welcome.message: To transfer playback between your phone and PC, turn off Count extension plays on Spotify in MySpoti and keep Resume Eclipse when returning to this phone enabled in this extension. You may briefly hear Spotify before Eclipse resumes. There is no need to switch audio sources manually.
steps: On a PC, open https://eclipsemusic.app/account and sign in to your Eclipse account.
Press F12 → Application/Storage → Local Storage → https://eclipsemusic.app. Find eclipse_token and copy only its value.
Paste that value into Eclipse account token in this extension's settings. This is not your Google password.
In your Eclipse account: Support the project → Eclipse addon → Copy. Paste the link into Eclipse addon URL.
Turn off MySpoti's Count extension plays on Spotify setting and put Eclipse first in playback and download sources.

changelog: All extension interface text, setup instructions, permission explanations, diagnostics and public documentation are now in English. Playback and Connect behavior are unchanged. The token and addon URL fields remain empty in the public package.
